counts.sql: SELECT SUM(bom_level>0 AND alt_priority=0), COUNT(DISTINCT IF(bom_level>0 AND alt_priority=0,material_code,NULL)), SUM(bom_level>0 AND alt_priority<>0), SUM(bom_level>0), COUNT(DISTINCT IF(bom_level>0,material_code,NULL)) FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='382-000005';

shared_two.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT material_code FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code IN ('382-000005','P61-000351') AND bom_level>0 AND alt_priority=0 GROUP BY material_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bom_material_code)=2) AS shared;

shared_three.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT material_code FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code IN ('382-000005','P61-000351','U00-000151') AND bom_level>0 AND alt_priority=0 GROUP BY material_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bom_material_code)=3) AS shared;

level_counts.sql: SELECT bom_level,COUNT(*) FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='382-000005' AND alt_priority=0 AND bom_level>0 GROUP BY bom_level ORDER BY bom_level;

backward_affected_row.sql: SELECT material_code,parent_material_code,bom_level,alt_priority,alt_method FROM supply_demo_hand.erp_material_bom WHERE bom_material_code='U00-000080' AND material_code IN ('454-000033','588-000496');
